fullText.simplified:
特别的工作

    如果这个美丽的女子一直低头看书，周明会不会试着和她说话？周明也在想着这个问题。还好，老天帮了他。
    一朵黑云飘来，街上一下子就暗了。这个女子也不得不从书里抬起头看看天，好像想知道这朵讨厌的黑云什么时候过去。她那双美丽的眼睛轻轻地从周明这边飘走，又轻轻飘回来——她看到了一个外表英俊、迷人的年轻男人。
    周明的心跳得更快了。
    女子对着周明笑了一笑，没有说话，但周明的心却好像被春风吹过一样，没那么紧张了。周明也对女子微微一笑。
    忽然，他想到了什么。
    这个女子住的地方，大门开着，好像是一家商店，又看不到任何人卖东西。和别的房子不同，这个房子的门窗上都有美丽的花样，地上晒了一些红的、绿的、黄的花伞，楼上的窗户还晒了一些颜色艳丽的衣服，几个女人正在雨中收着衣服。
    很明显，与其说这是商店，不如说这是一个乐府。女子们在这里住着，上午休息，下午就开始工作：为大家唱歌、跳舞、弹琴。而街上的男人们，就是她们的客人。
    在那个时候的中国，男人可以读书、考试，女人却不能。男人们只要认识字，就可以读任何书，还可以去任何地方游学，甚至参加考试，当上大官。而女人，特别是在乐府工作的歌女，常常是最让人看不起的。
      周明的心情有些复杂。那个女子也并没有说话，只是微笑着，对他点点头。说真的，她确实是一个大美人，周明又一次心想。
fullText.traditional:
特別的工作

    如果這個美麗的女子一直低頭看書，周明會不會試著和她說話？周明也在想著這個問題。還好，老天幫了他。
    一朵黑雲飄來，街上一下子就暗了。這個女子也不得不從書裡抬起頭看看天，好像想知道這朵討厭的黑雲什麼時候過去。她那雙美麗的眼睛輕輕地從周明這邊飄走，又輕輕飄回來——她看到了一個外表英俊、迷人的年輕男人。
    周明的心跳得更快了。
    女子對著周明笑了一笑，沒有說話，但周明的心卻好像被春風吹過一樣，沒那麼緊張了。周明也對女子微微一笑。
    忽然，他想到了什麼。
    這個女子住的地方，大門開著，好像是一家商店，又看不到任何人賣東西。和別的房子不同，這個房子的門窗上都有美麗的花樣，地上曬了一些紅的、綠的、黃的花傘，樓上的窗戶還曬了一些顏色艷麗的衣服，幾個女人正在雨中收著衣服。
    很明顯，與其說這是商店，不如說這是一個樂府。女子們在這裡住著，上午休息，下午就開始工作：為大家唱歌、跳舞、彈琴。而街上的男人們，就是她們的客人。
    在那個時候的中國，男人可以讀書、考試，女人卻不能。男人們只要認識字，就可以讀任何書，還可以去任何地方遊學，甚至參加考試，當上大官。而女人，特別是在樂府工作的歌女，常常是最讓人看不起的。
      周明的心情有些複雜。那個女子也並沒有說話，只是微笑著，對他點點頭。說真的，她確實是一個大美人，周明又一次心想。

sentences.traditional: 如果這個美麗的女子一直低頭看書，周明會不會試著和她說話？
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ zhè ge měi lì de nǚ zǐ yì zhí dī tóu kàn shū zhōu míng huì bú huì shì zhe hé tā shuō huà
sentences.english: If this beautiful woman kept reading the book with her head down, would Zhou Ming try to talk to her?

sentences.simplified: 周明也在想着这个问题。还好，老天帮了他。
sentences.traditional: 周明也在想著這個問題。還好，老天幫了他。
sentences.pinyin: zhōu míng yě zài xiǎng zhe zhè ge wèn tí hái hǎo lǎo tiān bāng le tā
sentences.english: Zhou Ming was also thinking about this question. Fortunately, the heavens helped him.

sentences.simplified: 一朵黑云飘来，街上一下子就暗了。
sentences.traditional: 一朵黑雲飄來，街上一下子就暗了。
sentences.pinyin: yì duǒ hēi yún piāo lái jiē shang yí xià zi jiù àn le
sentences.english: A black cloud came floating over, and the street suddenly became dark.

sentences.simplified: 这个女子也不得不从书里抬起头看看天，
sentences.traditional: 這個女子也不得不從書裡抬起頭看看天，
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge nǚ zǐ yě bù dé bù cóng shū lǐ tái qǐ tóu kàn kan tiān
sentences.english: The woman also couldn’t help looking up at the sky from the book, ..

sentences.simplified: 好像想知道这朵讨厌的黑云什么时候过去。
sentences.traditional: 好像想知道這朵討厭的黑雲什麼時候過去。
sentences.pinyin: hǎo xiàng xiǎng zhī dào zhè duǒ tǎo yàn de hēi yún shén me shí hou guò qù
sentences.english: .. as if she wanted to know when this nasty black cloud would pass.

sentences.simplified: 她那双美丽的眼睛轻轻地从周明这边飘走，又轻轻飘回来——
sentences.traditional: 她那雙美麗的眼睛輕輕地從周明這邊飄走，又輕輕飄回來——
sentences.pinyin: tā nà shuāng měi lì de yǎn jing qīng qīng de cóng zhōu míng zhè biān piāo zǒu yòu qīng qīng piāo huí lai
sentences.english: Her beautiful eyes gently floated away from Zhou Ming and then gently floated back.

sentences.simplified: 她看到了一个外表英俊、迷人的年轻男人。
sentences.traditional: 她看到了一個外表英俊、迷人的年輕男人。
sentences.pinyin: tā kàn dào le yí ge wài biǎo yīng jùn mí rén de nián qīng nán rén
sentences.english: She saw a handsome and enchanting young man.

sentences.simplified: 周明的心跳得更快了。
sentences.traditional: 周明的心跳得更快了。
sentences.pinyin: zhōu míng de xīn tiào de gèng kuài le
sentences.english: Zhou Ming’s heart beat faster.

sentences.simplified: 女子对着周明笑了一笑，没有说话，
sentences.traditional: 女子對著周明笑了一笑，沒有說話，
sentences.pinyin: nǚ zǐ duì zhe zhōu míng xiào le yí xiào méi yǒu shuō huà
sentences.english: The woman smiled at Zhou Ming and did not speak.

sentences.simplified: 但周明的心却好像被春风吹过一样，没那么紧张了。
sentences.traditional: 但周明的心卻好像被春風吹過一樣，沒那麼緊張了。
sentences.pinyin: dàn zhōu míng de xīn què hǎo xiàng bèi chūn fēng chuī guò yí yàng méi nà me jǐn zhāng le
sentences.english: But Zhou Ming’s heart was as if it had been blown by a spring breeze, and he was less nervous.

sentences.simplified: 周明也对女子微微一笑。
sentences.traditional: 周明也對女子微微一笑。
sentences.pinyin: zhōu míng yě duì nǚ zǐ wēi wēi yí xiào
sentences.english: Zhou Ming also smiled faintly at the woman.

sentences.simplified: 忽然，他想到了什么。
sentences.traditional: 忽然，他想到了什麼。
sentences.pinyin: hū rán tā xiǎng dào le shén me
sentences.english: Suddenly, he thought of something.

sentences.simplified: 这个女子住的地方，大门开着，好像是一家商店，又看不到任何人卖东西。
sentences.traditional: 這個女子住的地方，大門開著，好像是一家商店，又看不到任何人賣東西。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge nǚ zǐ zhù de dì fang dà mén kāi zhe hǎo xiàng shì yì jiā shāng diàn yòu kàn bú dào rèn hé rén mài dōng xi
sentences.english: The door was open to the place where the woman lived. It seemed to be a shop, but no one could be seen selling anything.

sentences.simplified: 和别的房子不同，这个房子的门窗上都有美丽的花样，
sentences.traditional: 和別的房子不同，這個房子的門窗上都有美麗的花樣，
sentences.pinyin: hé bié de fáng zi bù tóng zhè ge fáng zi de mén chuāng shang dōu yǒu měi lì de huā yàng
sentences.english: Unlike other houses, there were beautiful patterns on the doors and windows of this house.

sentences.simplified: 地上晒了一些红的、绿的、黄的花伞，
sentences.traditional: 地上曬了一些紅的、綠的、黃的花傘，
sentences.pinyin: dì shang shài le yì xiē hóng de lǜ de huáng de huā sǎn
sentences.english: Some red, green, and yellow floral parasols were on the ground.

sentences.simplified: 楼上的窗户还晒了一些颜色艳丽的衣服，几个女人正在雨中收着衣服。
sentences.traditional: 樓上的窗戶還曬了一些顏色艷麗的衣服，幾個女人正在雨中收著衣服。
sentences.pinyin: lóu shàng de chuāng hu hái shài le yì xiē yán sè yàn lì de yī fu jǐ ge nǚ rén zhèng zài yǔ zhōng shōu zhe yī fu
sentences.english: Some brightly colored clothes were by the upstairs windows, and several women were in the rain bringing in the clothes.

sentences.simplified: 很明显，与其说这是商店，不如说这是一个乐府。
sentences.traditional: 很明顯，與其說這是商店，不如說這是一個樂府。
sentences.pinyin: hěn míng xiǎn yǔ qí shuō zhè shì shāng diàn bù rú shuō zhè shì yí ge yuè fǔ
sentences.english: Obviously, this was not so much a shop as it was a music bureau.

sentences.simplified: 女子们在这里住着，上午休息，下午就开始工作：
sentences.traditional: 女子們在這裡住著，上午休息，下午就開始工作：
sentences.pinyin: nǚ zǐ men zài zhè lǐ zhù zhe shàng wǔ xiū xi xià wǔ jiù kāi shǐ gōng zuò
sentences.english: The women lived here, rested in the morning, and started work in the afternoon.

sentences.simplified: 为大家唱歌、跳舞、弹琴。而街上的男人们，就是她们的客人。
sentences.traditional: 為大家唱歌、跳舞、彈琴。而街上的男人們，就是她們的客人。
sentences.pinyin: wèi dà jiā chàng gē tiào wǔ tán qín ér jiē shang de nán rén men jiù shì tā men de kè rén
sentences.english: They sang, danced, and played music for everyone, and the men on the street were their customers.

sentences.simplified: 在那个时候的中国，男人可以读书、考试，女人却不能。
sentences.traditional: 在那個時候的中國，男人可以讀書、考試，女人卻不能。
sentences.pinyin: zài nà ge shí hou de zhōng guó nán rén kě yǐ dú shū kǎo shì nǚ rén què bù néng
sentences.english: In China at that time, men could study and take exams, but women could not.

sentences.simplified: 男人们只要认识字，就可以读任何书，
sentences.traditional: 男人們只要認識字，就可以讀任何書，
sentences.pinyin: nán rén men zhǐ yào rèn shi zì jiù kě yǐ dú rèn hé shū
sentences.english: Men could read any book as long as they knew the characters.

sentences.simplified: 还可以去任何地方游学，甚至参加考试，当上大官。
sentences.traditional: 還可以去任何地方遊學，甚至參加考試，當上大官。
sentences.pinyin: hái kě yǐ qù rèn hé dì fang yóu xué shèn zhì cān jiā kǎo shì dāng shang dà guān
sentences.english: They could go to any place and study,  and even take exams and become high officials.

sentences.simplified: 而女人，特别是在乐府工作的歌女，常常是最让人看不起的。
sentences.traditional: 而女人，特別是在樂府工作的歌女，常常是最讓人看不起的。
sentences.pinyin: ér nǚ rén tè bié shì zài yuè fǔ gōng zuò de gē nǚ cháng cháng shì zuì ràng rén kàn bu qǐ de
sentences.english: But women, especially the performers who worked in the music bureau, were often the most despised.

sentences.simplified: 周明的心情有些复杂。那个女子也并没有说话，只是微笑着，对他点点头。
sentences.traditional: 周明的心情有些複雜。那個女子也並沒有說話，只是微笑著，對他點點頭。
sentences.pinyin: zhōu míng de xīn qíng yǒu xiē fù zá nà ge nǚ zǐ yě bìng méi yǒu shuō huà zhǐ shì wēi xiào zhe duì tā diǎn diǎn tóu
sentences.english: Zhou Ming had somewhat mixed feelings. The woman did not speak either; she just smiled and nodded to him.

sentences.simplified: 说真的，她确实是一个大美人，周明又一次心想。
sentences.traditional: 說真的，她確實是一個大美人，周明又一次心想。
sentences.pinyin: shuō zhēn de tā què shí shì yí ge dà měi rén zhōu míng yòu yí cì xīn xiǎng
sentences.english: To be honest, she is indeed a great beauty, Zhou Ming thought to himself again.

sentence_translations: An Unusual Job
If this beautiful woman kept reading the book with her head down, would Zhou Ming try to talk to her?
Zhou Ming was also thinking about this question. Fortunately, the heavens helped him.
A black cloud came floating over, and the street suddenly became dark.
The woman also couldn’t help looking up at the sky from the book, ..
.. as if she wanted to know when this nasty black cloud would pass.
Her beautiful eyes gently floated away from Zhou Ming and then gently floated back.
She saw a handsome and enchanting young man.
Zhou Ming’s heart beat faster.
The woman smiled at Zhou Ming and did not speak.
But Zhou Ming’s heart was as if it had been blown by a spring breeze, and he was less nervous.
Zhou Ming also smiled faintly at the woman.
Suddenly, he thought of something.
The door was open to the place where the woman lived. It seemed to be a shop, but no one could be seen selling anything.
Unlike other houses, there were beautiful patterns on the doors and windows of this house.
Some red, green, and yellow floral parasols were on the ground.
Some brightly colored clothes were by the upstairs windows, and several women were in the rain bringing in the clothes.
Obviously, this was not so much a shop as it was a music bureau.
The women lived here, rested in the morning, and started work in the afternoon.
They sang, danced, and played music for everyone, and the men on the street were their customers.
In China at that time, men could study and take exams, but women could not.
Men could read any book as long as they knew the characters.
They could go to any place and study,  and even take exams and become high officials.
But women, especially the performers who worked in the music bureau, were often the most despised.
Zhou Ming had somewhat mixed feelings. The woman did not speak either; she just smiled and nodded to him.
To be honest, she is indeed a great beauty, Zhou Ming thought to himself again.
